name: sgn
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::sgn(Tensor self) -> Tensor. Returns the real sign or normalized complex phase elementwise without mutating the input. The shared legacy correctness file also preserves coverage for the in-place and out overload families, including integer, boolean and complex dtypes, special and nonfinite values, empty and noncontiguous tensors, out-buffer resizing and dtype rejection. Effects below describe only the representative functional signature.
